title: Monotonicity of recursive majority
statement: For every natural number $n$, every depth $d\in\mathbb{N}$, and any two sign inputs $x,y$ indexed by $n^d$ coordinates, if $x_i\le y_i$ at every coordinate, then recursive majority of depth $d$ on $x$ is at most recursive majority of depth $d$ on $y$.
hypotheses_covered: Two sign inputs indexed by $n^d$ coordinates
